node.statement: Fix j in C, put A_j:=A_{\{j\}}, epsilon_j:=W.L*epsilon, and t_atom:=W.K_call*epsilon. By lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope and the structural inequalities, A_j is an extended epsilon_j-C*-algebra with 0<=epsilon_j<=t_atom<=W.r_reset; the one-dimensional atomic-image hypothesis gives dim A_j=1. Apply the compressed-corner scalar instance of lem-maincb-initial-raw-inclusion together with the scalar producer clause of lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger to obtain the literal scalar map u_j:C->A_j as an extended D_* t_atom-isomorphism satisfying ||u_j(I_C)-u_{A_j}||<=D_* t_atom, where D_*>=1.
